correctness.rationale: The precise C4 square C5 graph and free C5 action are defined. Complete exact integer orbit-chain enumeration gives face-orbit counts (4,30,108,202,204,118,40,6), one order-five boundary after 353 integer unit cancellations, and no other quotient differential. The original chain cancels 1778 pairs to its complete integral homology. Group presentations built independently from triangle attaching words reduce by valid Tietze moves to the trivial original group and C5 quotient. The original is 2-connected by degree-two Hurewicz, making H3 its third homotopy group. Transfer fixes the C5 deck action on H3. Naturality and the Serre spectral sequence prove that alpha cup Bockstein(alpha) survives in degree three. All critical integer and group calculations replay from the actual standalone checker; finite modular rank tests at 2,3,5,7 independently corroborate the matrices.

value.rationale: The canonical coprime 4-by-5 periodic hard-square model was prominent in the classical Euler-characteristic/rhombus-tiling literature. Its free translation orbit space is a natural, fully specified symmetry quotient. Exact simultaneous order-five torsion, two third-degree free classes, one fourth-degree free class, low homotopy and a nonzero mod-five product give substantial topological information invisible to the classical Euler count. In particular the product rules out the naive wedge description even though that wedge has the same integral homology. The exact finite case has a motivated invariant and an independent use in comparing periodic symmetry quotients; no unsupported parameter-general theorem is asserted.
